We do not recommend the pizza.
Sep 2025 • Couples
We came for dinner after happy hour finished to avoid a long wait for a pizza, as described by so many TA reviewers. We were the only customers at 9.00pm. We received our freshly made meat lovers pizza (with half olives) within 15 minutes of ordering. We were pleased to see that all the ingredients were brought out from the kitchen in sealed Tupperware containers to the pizza making area. The pizza was edible, but it was too dry, and the crust tasted floury. The fresh draught beer at 10k VND was bitter but cold
